title: Baseline record
description: One patient at the start of a systemic therapy line, as planned in usual care. One record per patient, shared by all scenarios. A scenario can adapt the starting dose and the G-CSF prophylaxis; the observation records show what was given.

tumour_type.title: Tumour type
tumour_type.description: Primary tumour. All patients have advanced disease.

subgroup.title: Subgroup
subgroup.description: Disease setting within the tumour type.

regimen.title: Regimen
regimen.description: Systemic therapy that starts on day 1.

prior_therapy_lines.title: Earlier therapy lines
prior_therapy_lines.description: Number of earlier systemic therapy lines for advanced disease.

starting_dose_level.title: Starting dose level
starting_dose_level.description: Dose in the first cycle as a fraction of the standard dose.

gcsf_prophylaxis.title: G-CSF prophylaxis
gcsf_prophylaxis.description: G-CSF is given with each chemotherapy cycle to prevent neutropenia.

adt_type.title: Androgen deprivation
adt_type.description: Type of the androgen deprivation therapy that runs alongside the regimen. Null for patients without prostate cancer.

ecog.title: ECOG
ecog.description: ECOG performance status at therapy start.

ga_impaired_domains.title: Impaired geriatric domains
ga_impaired_domains.description: Number of impaired domains in a geriatric assessment (physical function, cognition, emotional health, comorbidity, polypharmacy, nutrition, social support). Null if no assessment was done.

renal_function.title: Renal function
renal_function.description: Renal function category derived from egfr_ml_min: normal from 90, mild decrease from 60 to 89, moderate or severe decrease below 60.

bilirubin_ratio_uln.title: Bilirubin
bilirubin_ratio_uln.unit: multiple of the upper limit of normal
bilirubin_ratio_uln.description: Total bilirubin relative to the upper limit of normal.

lung_comorbidity.title: Lung comorbidity
lung_comorbidity.description: Asthma, COPD, earlier interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, pulmonary fibrosis, emphysema or radiation pneumonitis.

cardiovascular_disease.title: Cardiovascular disease
cardiovascular_disease.description: Established cardiovascular disease, with or without an earlier major cardiovascular event.

prior_cardiovascular_event.title: Earlier cardiovascular event
prior_cardiovascular_event.description: Earlier myocardial infarction or stroke. Implies cardiovascular disease.

arterial_hypertension.title: Arterial hypertension
arterial_hypertension.description: Known arterial hypertension, treated or untreated.

years_since_diagnosis.title: Years since diagnosis
years_since_diagnosis.description: Time from first cancer diagnosis to therapy start.
